scope_notes: All original events remain in N. No selected-subset denominator, 2/3 factor, luminosity factor or fit result used.
Nominal rate is sum_j alpha_j*K*sigma_j*f_j; its factorizing fraction is rate/sum_j alpha_j*K*sigma_j. Raw selected/60000 is shown separately.
Fixed-N conditional plug-in variances use independent Bernoulli selections within each stream. Histogram sumw2 remains the distinct Poissonized MC convention and original 5% floor.
The >=10 selected and >=10 unselected per stream rule is a prospective Gaussian-support safeguard, not a coverage proof. No global multiplicity-controlled equivalence assertion.
Generator integration errors are the final printed MG summaries. K/PDF/scale/detector/selection systematic uncertainties and integration-selection covariance are not supplied.

Historical source receipts authenticate original producer runtime and artifact bytes; this reader is not claiming to rerun under that runtime. Later fit failure is preserved and is not a missing selection receipt.

limitations: These are interventions on signal modifier lists in the same supplied official likelihood. Background content, supplied signal nominal values and observed data remain fixed by the reviewed preparation.

Signal-MC-only retains normfactor plus supplied staterror/shapesys. Nominal-only retains normfactor alone. Shared background nuisance parameters remain; removing signal staterror can change a shared constraint without changing parameter count.

The report rereads stored results and receipts only. It does not rerun conditional optimizations, prove global minima, convert to a physical cross section, calibrate detector response, or transfer official nuisance effects to a native signal.
